notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Body Dropper, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
